name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (भारत सरकार मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती - अनुसूचित जाती)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Provides reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees and monthly maintenance allowance to eligible SC/Nav-Bouddha students pursuing post-matric studies with parental annual income up to Rs. 2,50,000. (DRAFT CANDIDATE - NON-PRODUCTION)
benefits: 100% reimbursement of tuition fees, examination fees, and other compulsory non-refundable course fees
Monthly maintenance allowance categorized across Course Groups I to IV for hostellers and day scholars
Additional disability allowances for eligible scholars with benchmark disabilities
required_documents: Caste Certificate (SC / Nav-Bouddha) issued by Sub-Divisional Officer / Deputy Collector
Caste Validity Certificate (mandatory for professional and degree courses)
Income Certificate (<= Rs. 2,50,000) issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar)
SSC/10th Marksheet and qualifying examination marksheets
Current year college fee receipt and admission confirmation letter

sources.source_name: MoSJE Central Scheme Guidelines (15th FC Cycle)
sources.evidence_excerpt: Centrally Sponsored Scheme Guidelines (Letter No. 14011/1/2020-SCD-V): Scheme provides financial assistance to SC students pursuing post-matric studies. Parental annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/-. Operative 60:40 fund split.

शासन निर्णय क्र. बीसीएस-२०२०/प्र.क्र.२५/शिक्षण-२ दिनांक ३१ मार्च २०२१: केंद्र पुरस्कृत भारत सरकार मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती योजना सुधारित मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे राज्यात लागू. अनुसूचित जाती व नवबौद्ध विद्यार्थ्यांना शिक्षण शुल्क, परीक्षा शुल्क व निर्वाह भत्ता अनुज्ञेय.
MahaDBT 2.0 Notification for AY 2026-27: Fresh and renewal applications invited for Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students. Mandatory biometric/OTP Aadhaar authentication.

evidence.source_title: MoSJE Scheme Guidelines & Maharashtra Adoption GR
evidence.verbatim_excerpt: The scholarships are awarded by the government of the State to which the applicant actually belongs (permanently settled).
evidence.notes: Administered continuously; 16th Finance Commission revised central guidelines pending official gazette notification.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: The scholarships are available only to students belonging to Scheduled Castes.
evidence.notes: In Maharashtra, recognizes Scheduled Castes and Nav-Bouddha community.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: The scholarship will be provided for post-matriculation studies in recognized institutions.
Parental annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/-.
evidence.notes: Distinct from Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students which has an Rs. 8 Lakh ceiling and applies to premier institutes only.
